verdict.label: duplicate
verdict.why: Both GeoCountryList components are the same UI concept. They share the props contract, the sqrt opacity scale (domain [0,maxTokens], range [0.26,0.96], clamped), the ol/li/button structure, the active-state attribute, the --geo-row-opacity style, the three activation handlers (click, pointerenter, focus), and the rank/name/tokens/share row layout. This is a copy-pasted component that should be extracted into one shared component, for example in a shared stats components module. The legitimate variations are accessibility and i18n details. NEW adds an aria-label and passes the i18n object to formatCountryName, while EXISTING passes an unknown-label string and adds a visually-hidden tokens unit. Those can be handled through props or a label/format callback. The two copies have already drifted slightly in how formatCountryName is called, which is a further reason to share the component.

verdict.why: One portable domain concept can share an implementation; review behavior differences before moving it.

source_adjudication.owner: Each route locally owns GeoCountryList and its GeoPanel invokes it with topCountries/activeCountry/maxTokens/setActiveCountry. Both import d3-scale and local i18n. Neither calls a shared country-list implementation. A shared stats component with accessible-label/format callbacks is a useful common owner of visualization/selection behavior.
source_adjudication.resolution: Jev drifted .94 versus Claude duplicate .90: both support shared ownership, but source does not establish that differing accessible labels are erroneous divergence. Propose duplicate only for the invariant row interaction/opacity/rendering operation, preserving accessibility/i18n variation. Do not promote to whole-component equivalence or silently merge label differences.

source_adjudication.scope: Shared opacity scaling, active-country state and country-row selection/rendering operation only. Entire component bodies are context; full accessibility output equivalence is expressly not asserted.
source_adjudication.variation: Model route supplies composite aria-label and formatCountryName(country,locale,i18n). Home route has hidden translated token-unit text and passes i18n.t(home.unknown) to its local formatter. Both local formatters uppercase codes, map ZZ to the same translated unknown label, reject invalid numeric IDs and use Intl.DisplayNames. Accessibility DOM output genuinely differs and must remain configurable/preserved; source supplies no defect specification that makes it an unintended drift.
